summary: Licence problems and missing rights now come with a clear reason.

new.title: Policy as code names its missing right
new.text: Git push and read in Policy as code need a Key Vault right your administrator grants. Until then they stop and name the right; the zip download works without it.
new.action: Ask your Key Vault administrator to grant the right Policy as code names before you use Git push and read.

fixes.title: Clear reason when a licence is refused
fixes.text: When Invardia refuses a licence request, the update run's log now shows Invardia's reason.
